Linguistic Landscape Analyzer v1.0.0

- Initial release of a professional linguistic landscape analysis tool for research and social media monitoring.
- Provides sentiment analysis (中文 & English) and keyword extraction tools.
- Supports reading and managing 小红书 notes data via CSV or sample sources.
- Generates automated weekly analysis reports in Markdown format.
- Fully documented installation and usage instructions for researchers and data analysts.
